_owner: Design SB — what the 2026-08-19 GPT Design crit changed, finding by finding. Rendered on design-engine.html so the question 'what was updated based on the crit?' is answerable from the page rather than from a chat log.
_note: Every numbered finding and build phase in the controlling brief, with an honest state — not only the ones that were acted on. 'affirmed' means the crit ACCEPTED existing work and no change was needed; counting those as wins would overclaim. A response record that lists only what was done is a marketing page.

crit.title: Design Lane — Final Executive Implementation Brief + Work Order
crit.status: controlling — supersedes the earlier Design handover where they conflict

responses.asked: build the integration shell BEFORE more lenses — it is infrastructure, not the culmination
responses.did: Built and live. The DWS had it as build #8, 'after the lenses exist'; it is now first on this page too.

responses.asked: the SSOT rule 'the page is the authority' is incompatible with a headless architecture
responses.did: Corrected in SSOT_contributor_rules v2: the canonical store owns truth, the page is a rendered view, a discrepancy is a rendering defect.

responses.asked: 'render from data' is correct but overbroad — Design legitimately authors the encounter
responses.did: The binding line adopted: every DATA-DEPENDENT or ANALYTICAL proposition resolves to a declared source; copy, sequence, pacing and encoding stay Design's.

responses.asked: make the four epistemic planes canonical
responses.did: Method fact / Library fact / Design editorial / reader state, carried per surface in the Design State Registry.

responses.asked: 'silence' is semantically overloaded — type the absence before you aestheticize it
responses.did: Six typed states in the shell; Method S180 then ruled textual silence is not an absence at all and 16:8 became a coded move.

responses.asked: two kinds of 'convergence' — textual alignment vs agent agreement — never render both ambiguously
responses.did: Method locked the four-way split. Verified: the reading room renders none of senses 2/3/4 with the bare word.

responses.asked: the project has enough figures; it needs one grammar of interaction
responses.did: Select once → align everywhere, and the text never moves: opening a lens shifts the stage by a CSS transform.

responses.asked: design-engine.html and design-principles.html are good render-from-data patterns — ACCEPT
responses.did: No action needed; both already fetch their feeds. The feeds inside them needed the work, not the pages.

responses.asked: root Library stats are a stale GENERATED SNAPSHOT, not a hardcode — the defect is silent staleness
responses.did: The corpus panel reads /counts.json and shows its own age past 30 days. The Librarian then ruled the whole shape wrong — a headline must not substitute a larger easier number for a smaller defensible one — so it is now registered / held / reference-only, with serve-readiness stated as a gap.

responses.asked: all.html, viz_house_pattern.html and design_engine.json hardcode mutable status
responses.did: All three derive from the registry's eight axes now. design_engine's axes are DERIVED by a generator, not hand-typed — which immediately caught three nodes contradicting their own machine records.

responses.asked: reorder the DWS build sequence — move the shell to the front
responses.did: Shell built first; this page now opens with it.

responses.asked: 'finalize once, reuse everywhere' is good semantically, risky visually — reuse the contract, not the form
responses.did: Recorded in the visual grammar: same data + same semantics + shared interaction contract; form may adapt to context.

responses.asked: REMOVE 'the academic skin is the source of truth'
responses.did: Corrected. Neither skin is; the canonical output is. This was the SSOT confusion surviving one layer below where we had already fixed it.

responses.asked: REJECT 'one skeleton, swap tradition config' as a universal law
responses.did: Accepted for the Gospel prototype, rejected as universal — imposing one tradition's textual architecture on all others is what Method is trying not to do conceptually.

responses.asked: REJECT 'distance-from-centre = authority' as a general encoding
responses.did: Reworded to information architecture; spatial distance must not encode authority unless the data supports it.

responses.asked: the open ring is excellent for TESTED absence — do not reuse it for the other kinds
responses.did: Method RULING 1 confirmed two orthogonal axes; viz_principles line 96 corrected (it had given the ring to 'not coded', which is the dot).

responses.asked: Design may author what the MARK means; Method owns what the textual RELATIONSHIP means
responses.did: Observed throughout — the shell renders Method's wording verbatim and marks its own editorial as editorial.

responses.asked: the Labyrinth's 'relevance guarantee' overstates a title match
responses.did: Renamed to 'minimum inclusion gate' — a deterministic curation gate, not a semantic claim.

responses.asked: the Garden's one-dataset-two-forms architecture is a strong headless pattern — ACCEPT
responses.did: No action; Labyrinth/Mandala kept as is.

responses.asked: keep the three lanes clean: Library custody → Method analysis → Design rendering
responses.did: Held all session; every cross-lane finding was routed rather than fixed in place.

responses.asked: add a real Design adapter layer with declared owner / version / fields / non-claims per record
responses.did: The reading-room feed declares its sources, planes, key regime and non-claims. There is no general adapter layer across surfaces yet.

responses.asked: build the Method Output Registry → Design Coverage Registry seam
responses.did: Not built. The coverage map is still the provisional Design-side one, which is exactly what this finding says to stop doing.

responses.asked: the anchor contract is P0 infrastructure — select once, align everywhere
responses.did: One canonical verse_id and a namespaced move handle, declared as adapters. Method has since shipped the store's move_id and the adapters switched with no edit.

responses.asked: primary text persistent · reader QUESTIONS not engine names · progressive disclosure binding
responses.did: All three in the shell: text alone at L0, nine lenses named as questions, complexity arriving only when asked for.

responses.asked: the Talmudic inspiration should be structural, not 'boxes around a centre'
responses.did: Primary text sovereign, commentary anchored, voices attributable, disagreement uncollapsed — and the authority-by-distance metric explicitly rejected (F11).

responses.asked: Reading Room and Garden are siblings — do not collapse them
responses.did: Kept separate; different interaction mechanics preserved.

responses.asked: every thesis-critical surface gets a Design Surface Contract
responses.did: Registry records carry reader question, outputs consumed, anchor keys, presentational derivations, absence types, empty/stale state and non-claims.

responses.asked: add Design-specific tests — source sensitivity, hardcode audit, empty/stale state, anchors, provenance roundtrip, absence semantics, coldread, accessibility, visual regression
responses.did: 26 committed checks across two files, mutation-tested. Three could not go red and were rewritten. Accessibility found seven contrast failures and a keyboard reader who could select but not see.

responses.asked: retain the four-check gate but refine it — Cold Start must require owner, version and anchor contract, not merely a filename
responses.did: The feed names its run, its generator, and the exact command that reproduces it.

responses.asked: keep two modes, but neither is authoritative — a public surface may hide complexity, not change the finding
responses.did: Same correction as F9; recorded in the visual grammar.

responses.asked: keep Labyrinth and Mandala; keep Design curation explicit per artwork
responses.did: No action taken; the curation-basis fields are already specified in the Labyrinth DWS.

responses.asked: authority + output + anchor contracts
responses.did: Shipped before this session; the anchor half was completed here.

responses.asked: build the actual Mark 16 Reading Room shell
responses.did: Live. Definition of done met and measured: enter → read → select → reveal → compare → inspect provenance → return, without losing position.

responses.asked: typed negative-space grammar — distinct treatments per authorized absence type
responses.did: Blocked on DATA, not design. Two of the four absence kinds (GAP- 398 rows, XSRC- 123) reach no deployed feed, so a visual channel would have nothing to carry — and demonstrating it on invented data is what this finding warns against. Thesis-critical.

responses.asked: the Panel — show uncertainty WITHOUT converting a vote count into truth
responses.did: Ships as a refusal, which Method ruled is the answer. The agreement figure is deliberately absent from the page.

responses.asked: complete missing core outputs — Witness/transmission first
responses.did: Built as REACHED US, the ninth lens. Its degrees are a reconstruction, so the number never leads and the panel names the edge the estimate rests on.

responses.asked: Garden integration — owned hosting, corpus-generated journey, deep links
responses.did: Not started. The crit says it is not the current bottleneck unless hosting becomes an actual blocker.

responses.asked: (after the crit) the provenance badge certifies a key exists, not that the page rendered from that data
responses.did: The badge now verifies the page ACTUALLY FETCHED the feed it claims, using the browser's own resource timing. Three states. A surface audit then found the same shape on three pages, not one.
